authority: Maintainer requested a complete lang-item design; new roles/profiles remain proposals.

core.note: 22 keys are already registered today; the proposed profile mechanism and four additional roles are not implemented.

drop.semantic_contract: Destroy each remaining initialized unmoved owned value once; forbid explicit manual DropFn call that would double-destroy.
drop.safety_contract: Drop/Copy exclusivity, partial-move rules and overwrite cleanup remain enforced.
drop.generic_applicability: Any user-defined non-Copy owner, including generic captured or suspended state.
drop.abi_implications: No ABI change from this design document. Enabling roles requires compiler/metadata admission versioning and interface fingerprints as applicable.
drop.source_artifact_behavior: Resolve canonical owner/member identity in source and fresh .llib; retain signature, binder substitutions, safety and canonical lifetime; reject stale or conflicting bindings.
drop.why_existing_primitives_insufficient: Compiler-generated cleanup needs a checked destructor role, not an arbitrary ordinary method name.

copy.semantic_contract: Copy eligibility controls implicit value duplication without consuming the source.
copy.safety_contract: No owned non-Copy field or Drop conflict; never grants aliasing/exclusive-access permissions.
copy.generic_applicability: User-defined aggregates, generics and native/VM move analysis.
copy.abi_implications: No ABI change from this design document. Enabling roles requires compiler/metadata admission versioning and interface fingerprints as applicable.
copy.source_artifact_behavior: Resolve canonical owner/member identity in source and fresh .llib; retain signature, binder substitutions, safety and canonical lifetime; reject stale or conflicting bindings.
copy.why_existing_primitives_insufficient: Move checking must use canonical trait identity, including generic bounds, not text Copy.

option.semantic_contract: Iteration return protocol identifies presence/absence by variant identity and payload.
option.safety_contract: No fixed tag ordinal or same-layout substitution; contained ownership/provenance is preserved.
option.generic_applicability: Any Item, including non-Copy values and valid references.
option.abi_implications: No ABI change from this design document. Enabling roles requires compiler/metadata admission versioning and interface fingerprints as applicable.
option.source_artifact_behavior: Resolve canonical owner/member identity in source and fresh .llib; retain signature, binder substitutions, safety and canonical lifetime; reject stale or conflicting bindings.
option.why_existing_primitives_insufficient: Compiler-driven for needs checked branch roles; arbitrary enum names are insufficient.

iteration.semantic_contract: IntoIterator consumes once; Iterator::next borrows exclusively and returns Option<Item>.
iteration.safety_contract: Borrowed Item validity and exact cleanup on early exit; no lending/GAT promise.
iteration.generic_applicability: Arbitrary user iterable/iterator impls and generic binder identities.
iteration.abi_implications: No ABI change from this design document. Enabling roles requires compiler/metadata admission versioning and interface fingerprints as applicable.
iteration.source_artifact_behavior: Resolve canonical owner/member identity in source and fresh .llib; retain signature, binder substitutions, safety and canonical lifetime; reject stale or conflicting bindings.
iteration.why_existing_primitives_insufficient: Current one-required-method selection does not identify a member role when a trait evolves.

try.semantic_contract: Single evaluation; branch chooses Output or Residual; FromResidual constructs the enclosing return value.
try.safety_contract: Preserve owned residual and carried loans; no Error bound or implicit error conversion.
try.generic_applicability: Custom Try/FromResidual impls, not just Result/Option.
try.abi_implications: No ABI change from this design document. Enabling roles requires compiler/metadata admission versioning and interface fingerprints as applicable.
try.source_artifact_behavior: Resolve canonical owner/member identity in source and fresh .llib; retain signature, binder substitutions, safety and canonical lifetime; reject stale or conflicting bindings.
try.why_existing_primitives_insufficient: Associated Output/Residual projection and branch/residual members require identities, not member-name strings.

memory.semantic_contract: Drop in place and construct raw-backed slices with usize element counts.
memory.safety_contract: Unsafe call admission; alignment, live initialized storage, bounds, exclusive access and raw-origin/lifetime proof.
memory.generic_applicability: All sized T admitted by the existing memory primitive contract.
memory.abi_implications: No ABI change from this design document. Enabling roles requires compiler/metadata admission versioning and interface fingerprints as applicable.
memory.source_artifact_behavior: Resolve canonical owner/member identity in source and fresh .llib; retain signature, binder substitutions, safety and canonical lifetime; reject stale or conflicting bindings.
memory.why_existing_primitives_insufficient: Raw-to-safe construction and generic drop semantics cannot be replaced by arbitrary body/layout recognition.

wrapping.semantic_contract: Integer-only modular add/sub/mul modulo 2^width, independent of build mode.
wrapping.safety_contract: No implicit unchecked arithmetic or char/float/pointer admission.
wrapping.generic_applicability: Every admitted integer width and signedness after generic substitution.
wrapping.abi_implications: No ABI change from this design document. Enabling roles requires compiler/metadata admission versioning and interface fingerprints as applicable.
wrapping.source_artifact_behavior: Resolve canonical owner/member identity in source and fresh .llib; retain signature, binder substitutions, safety and canonical lifetime; reject stale or conflicting bindings.
wrapping.why_existing_primitives_insufficient: Ordinary arithmetic is checked; compiler primitive identity selects deliberate modular behavior.

operators.semantic_contract: Optional ordinary trait calls selected by syntax token and checked lang role.
operators.safety_contract: Normal move/borrow; no auto-clone; assignment place evaluated once; primitive arithmetic rules unchanged.
operators.generic_applicability: Unrelated user-defined numbers, matrices or values, not one known stdlib type.
operators.abi_implications: No ABI change from this design document. Enabling roles requires compiler/metadata admission versioning and interface fingerprints as applicable.
operators.source_artifact_behavior: Resolve canonical owner/member identity in source and fresh .llib; retain signature, binder substitutions, safety and canonical lifetime; reject stale or conflicting bindings.
operators.why_existing_primitives_insufficient: Syntax desugaring needs an explicit protocol if nominal operator dispatch is adopted.

comparison.semantic_contract: Use existing Eq.eq bool and Ord.cmp i32 sign protocols for optional nominal comparisons.
comparison.safety_contract: Borrow operands; no false total ordering for IEEE NaN and no new implicit numeric conversions.
comparison.abi_implications: No ABI change from this design document. Enabling roles requires compiler/metadata admission versioning and interface fingerprints as applicable.
comparison.source_artifact_behavior: Resolve canonical owner/member identity in source and fresh .llib; retain signature, binder substitutions, safety and canonical lifetime; reject stale or conflicting bindings.
comparison.why_existing_primitives_insufficient: Ordinary cmp calls work today; comparison syntax requires an opted-in hook, not a spelling match.

index_deref.semantic_contract: Safe index/deref yields receiver-bounded shared or exclusive reference.
index_deref.safety_contract: Invalid index checked failure; mutable capability, lifetime and overwrite/drop preserved; no new coercion via name.
index_deref.generic_applicability: Arbitrary owning/view container types with a sound reference-returning implementation.
index_deref.abi_implications: No ABI change from this design document. Enabling roles requires compiler/metadata admission versioning and interface fingerprints as applicable.
index_deref.source_artifact_behavior: Resolve canonical owner/member identity in source and fresh .llib; retain signature, binder substitutions, safety and canonical lifetime; reject stale or conflicting bindings.
index_deref.why_existing_primitives_insufficient: Place syntax needs checked return-place/provenance information; not every same-shaped function is equivalent.

callable.semantic_contract: Fn/FnMut/FnOnce distinguish shared, exclusive and consuming calls with tuple Args/Output roles.
callable.safety_contract: No safe erasure of unsafe callable; no lending environment output without separate lifetime design; exact captures drop.
callable.generic_applicability: Compiler-generated closures and ordinary user-defined callables.
callable.abi_implications: No ABI change from this design document. Enabling roles requires compiler/metadata admission versioning and interface fingerprints as applicable.
callable.source_artifact_behavior: Resolve canonical owner/member identity in source and fresh .llib; retain signature, binder substitutions, safety and canonical lifetime; reject stale or conflicting bindings.
callable.why_existing_primitives_insufficient: Explicit source call traits and their syntax routing do not follow merely from native closure representation.

async.semantic_contract: Future.poll receives context, returns Pending or one Ready output; cancellation uses generic Drop.
async.safety_contract: Self-referential futures remain prohibited; external loans live across suspension; no double poll/drop after completion.
async.generic_applicability: Generated futures and arbitrary user futures under the new opt-in protocol.
async.abi_implications: No ABI change from this design document. Enabling roles requires compiler/metadata admission versioning and interface fingerprints as applicable. Native Future type/layout migration also needs source compatibility and MVIR/VM/native validation.
async.source_artifact_behavior: Resolve canonical owner/member identity in source and fresh .llib; retain signature, binder substitutions, safety and canonical lifetime; reject stale or conflicting bindings.
async.why_existing_primitives_insufficient: Existing native Future machinery is not an ordinary trait/poll protocol; method/variant roles need an explicit design.

ranges.semantic_contract: Range syntax calls a checked ordinary range constructor; no hardcoded library struct fields.
ranges.safety_contract: Endpoints evaluate once, generic ownership and inclusive-MAX terminal rules preserved.
ranges.generic_applicability: Generic range implementations with ordinary Step/IntoIterator proofs.
ranges.abi_implications: No ABI change from this design document. Enabling roles requires compiler/metadata admission versioning and interface fingerprints as applicable.
ranges.source_artifact_behavior: Resolve canonical owner/member identity in source and fresh .llib; retain signature, binder substitutions, safety and canonical lifetime; reject stale or conflicting bindings.
ranges.why_existing_primitives_insufficient: Range expression construction needs a callee identity if native Range coupling is removed; range struct identity is unnecessary.

concurrency.semantic_contract: Reserved marker candidates for cross-thread transfer/shared-access contracts.
concurrency.safety_contract: Disabled until structural propagation, unsafe manual impl, pointer/borrow and scoped-lifetime rules are adopted.
concurrency.generic_applicability: Any type participating in a future fully specified thread safety model.
concurrency.abi_implications: No ABI change from this design document. Enabling roles requires compiler/metadata admission versioning and interface fingerprints as applicable.
concurrency.source_artifact_behavior: Resolve canonical owner/member identity in source and fresh .llib; retain signature, binder substitutions, safety and canonical lifetime; reject stale or conflicting bindings.
concurrency.why_existing_primitives_insufficient: Ordinary marker names cannot establish language-level cross-thread guarantees; this is not current support.
